scripts.dev: npm run contracts:build && npm run dev:prepare && node scripts/dev.mjs
scripts.dev:prepare: npm run db:up && npm run db:migrate
scripts.build: npm run contracts:build && npm run build --workspace @parking/api && npm run build --workspace @parking/web
scripts.lint: npm run contracts:build && npm run lint --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run contracts:build && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run contracts:build && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
